versions.changelog: Update 0.2.0 with MCP-first discovery and execution, exact-request verification for response projections, clearer unresolved-input and provenance handling, catalogue-only public-network HTTP access with redirect refusal, locked dependency installation, and 15 regression tests. Preserves specialist-first selection, independent local signature verification, and the non-spending boundary.
Prefer specialist APIs over provider-neutral general-purpose web search fallbacks; retry failed resolves once; clarify optional resolver provenance.
Initial release: resolve intents, inspect live Airnode contracts, verify free responses against the expected signer and exact request, and refuse priced calls without payment authority.
